title: Our Resident Tabulation Expert
text: y2clerk exists quickly create formatted frequencies tables. leverages tidyverse, allowing user |> data frames, select() lists variables, group_by() others, include weights frequencies. two main functions y2clerk: freqs() - creates frequency table including ns percentages level variable list variables. freqs() flexible can also used calculating means, medians, quartiles including weighting variables. verbatims_y2() - creates table similar formatting freqs. However, function used string variables creates table responses given. cross_freqs() - creates frequency table similar cross tabs. group_var given function acts unique banner every variable listed freqs. Whereas group_by %>% freqs produces set frequencies grouped single variable, cross_freqs designed produce set frequencies grouped multiple different grouping variables one another combines results single dataframe.

title: Run crosstabs in R — cross_freqs
text: dataset dataframe. group_vars Accepts character vector variable names. variables want subset freqeuncies. traditional crosstab, banner variables. ... unquoted names set variables dataset. nothing specified, function runs frequency every column given dataset. stat Character, stat run. Currently accepts 'percent,' 'mean,' 'median,' 'min,' 'max,' 'quantile,' 'summary' (default: 'percent'). percentile Double, use stat = 'quantile.' Input real number x 0 <= x <= 100. Stands percentile rank, quantile relative 100-point scale. (default:NULL) nas Boolean, whether include NAs tabulation (default: TRUE). wt unquoted name weighting variable dataset (default: NULL). prompt Boolean, whether include prompt dataset (default: FALSE). digits Integer, number significant digits rounding (default: 2). nas_group Boolean, whether include NA values grouping variable tabulation (default: TRUE). factor_group Boolean, whether convert grouping variable factor use labels instead underlying numeric values (default: FALSE) wide Boolean, whether dataframe one long dataframe (FALSE) wide nested dataframe, nested group_vars (TRUE) (default: FALSE) exclude_groups Boolean, argument applies group_vars also included freqs vars - group_vars included freqs vars using select() run cross_freqs variables dataset. FALSE INclude group_vars freqs vars. TRUE EXclude group_vars also freqs vars (default: FALSE) include_overall Boolean, whether include overall frequency levels variables (default = FALSE)
